story.title: ARTÉA: The Crown of Life
story.promise: Discover the wisdom, harmony, and creativity already alive within you, then bring their light home to the ARTÉA Castle.
story.central_need: The Castle has not been damaged and the player is never incomplete. Its paths have grown quiet because they awaken only when a person freely notices and shares their own light.
story.player_role: Lightbearer and co-author of the journey
story.theme: You are known, valued, uniquely created, and your light has a place in this universe.

principles: Never diagnose, score, or infer a child's inner state.
Never require personal disclosure or a correct emotion.
Offer pause, skip, replay, and neutral choices without penalty.
Treat every creation as the player's own meaning; prompts invite but never judge.
Store only explicit player actions already supported by JourneyState.

prologue.title: The Castle of Listening Light
prologue.purpose: Give the player agency and establish that the quest reveals existing strengths rather than repairing a broken self.
prologue.story_reason: The three celestial roads respond to lived choices, so the Castle asks for a Lightbearer who will awaken them in order.

dialogue.speaker: Milo
dialogue.faith: The Maker knows your light already. Nothing in you is a missing piece. Will you discover the gifts placed within you and carry their glow through the Castle?
dialogue.universal: Your light is already part of you. Nothing in you is a missing piece. Will you discover your gifts and carry their glow through the Castle?

beats: A dark-blue gallery unfolds into a living galaxy of art, music, memory, and stars.
Milo reveals three quiet roads: the Thought Constellation, the Heart Resonance Rail, and the Creator's Prism Path.
The player chooses Continue, Not yet, or Explore controls; only Continue completes the prologue.

kingdom_arcs.title: Mind Spark Kingdom
kingdom_arcs.subtitle: The Constellation of Chosen Hope
kingdom_arcs.theme: I can notice my thoughts and choose a helpful next thought.
kingdom_arcs.purpose: Build self-awareness, courage, and flexible thinking through safe, curated reframing.
kingdom_arcs.story_reason: A thought-star can guide the next road only after the player has noticed it, named its effect, and chosen where its light points.

arrival_dialogue.speaker: Everlasting Father
arrival_dialogue.faith: Truth is a lantern, not a test. I will walk beside you while you notice each thought and choose hope without pretending hard things are easy.
arrival_dialogue.universal: Wisdom is a lantern, not a test. I will walk beside you while you notice each thought and choose hope without pretending hard things are easy.

quests.title: Whispers in the Thought Sky
quests.purpose: Practise observing a thought without treating it as a fact or identity.
quests.story_reason: Unheard thought-clouds cover the first constellation, while noticed thoughts become visible stars.

tasks.title: Notice a Thought Cloud
tasks.mechanic_action: Choose one curated cloud or the neutral 'A thought is here' cloud; hold focus until its words become readable.
tasks.purpose: Separate noticing from believing or judging.
tasks.story_reason: The first hidden star appears when a cloud is witnessed rather than fought.
tasks.skip_policy: A neutral cloud completes the same learning goal without disclosure.
tasks.replay_policy: Replay any cloud; prior choices are never treated as a diagnosis.

dialogue.speaker: Everlasting Father
dialogue.faith: A thought can visit you without naming who God created you to be.
dialogue.universal: A thought can visit you without deciding who you are.

tasks.title: Name What the Cloud Does
tasks.mechanic_action: Pick one curated effect: makes things feel smaller, louder, rushed, hopeful, or unsure; 'not sure' is always available.
tasks.purpose: Grow emotional and cognitive vocabulary without asking for private details.
tasks.story_reason: Naming the cloud's movement reveals its safe path through the sky.
tasks.skip_policy: Choosing 'not sure' is complete and receives equal celebration.
tasks.replay_policy: The player may choose a different effect on replay without correction messaging.

tasks.title: Give the Cloud Some Space
tasks.mechanic_action: Use the split-lens gesture to move the cloud beside the player instead of over the whole view.
tasks.purpose: Represent cognitive distance through a concrete spatial action.
tasks.story_reason: With room around it, the cloud no longer hides the constellation.
tasks.skip_policy: An accessibility button performs the same move with no score penalty.
tasks.replay_policy: Unlimited practice; speed and precision are not scored.

quests.title: The Two Windows of Truth
quests.purpose: Choose a believable, compassionate next thought rather than forced positivity.
quests.story_reason: Two star-windows show that perspective can change while the real challenge remains acknowledged.

tasks.title: Open Both Windows
tasks.mechanic_action: Split the scene between a difficult curated thought and two truthful, hopeful alternatives.
tasks.purpose: Show multiple interpretations without labelling one feeling wrong.
tasks.story_reason: Both windows must be seen before the star-map can offer a route.
tasks.skip_policy: A read-aloud mode can reveal both windows automatically.
tasks.replay_policy: Alternative pairs remain curated and replayable.

tasks.title: Choose a Growing Thought
tasks.mechanic_action: Choose a believable reframe such as 'I am learning and growing' or 'I can ask for help.'
tasks.purpose: Practise agency and resilient self-talk.
tasks.story_reason: The selected words become a bridge of light rather than erasing the original cloud.
tasks.skip_policy: Choosing 'I want more time' saves no personal response and offers a neutral reframe.
tasks.replay_policy: The player can collect several helpful thoughts; none is ranked.

tasks.title: Cross the Hope Bridge
tasks.mechanic_action: Walk across platforms formed from the chosen words and light each word in sequence.
tasks.purpose: Turn reflection into a calm, embodied action.
tasks.story_reason: The completed sentence points the constellation home to ARTÉA.
tasks.skip_policy: Auto-cross is available after one attempt and grants identical progress.
tasks.replay_policy: No lives, timer, or failure state.

quests.title: The Wisdom Constellation
quests.purpose: Consolidate noticing, naming, and choosing into one strength the player can remember.
quests.story_reason: The Star of Wisdom forms only when the player recognizes their own courageous choices.

tasks.title: Trace Your Three Lights
tasks.mechanic_action: Connect the symbols for Notice, Name, and Choose in any visual pattern.
tasks.purpose: Rehearse the skill sequence without testing memory.
tasks.story_reason: The player's path, not a perfect shape, becomes the constellation.
tasks.skip_policy: A one-button constellation option completes it.
tasks.replay_policy: Every traced shape is accepted and can be remade.

tasks.title: Receive the Star of Wisdom
tasks.mechanic_action: Choose Receive now or Place it nearby; both animate the Star into the journey compass.
tasks.purpose: Celebrate demonstrated self-awareness while preserving bodily and spiritual consent.
tasks.story_reason: The Star turns the quiet Castle road toward the Heart Melody Kingdom.
tasks.skip_policy: Place nearby avoids crown/body imagery and awards the same treasure.
tasks.replay_policy: Ceremony may replay; treasure is idempotent.

dialogue.speaker: Everlasting Father
dialogue.faith: God-given courage helped you understand a thought and choose hope.
dialogue.universal: You found the courage to understand a thought and choose hope.

kingdom_arcs.title: Heart Melody Kingdom
kingdom_arcs.subtitle: The Garden of Many Voices
kingdom_arcs.theme: My feelings have a voice, and I can listen without being ruled by one note.
kingdom_arcs.purpose: Practise emotional expression, empathy, connection, and regulation through cooperative music.
kingdom_arcs.story_reason: The Rainbow Galaxy Train needs a true chord made from different feelings, not a single permanently happy note.

arrival_dialogue.speaker: Archangel Raphael
arrival_dialogue.faith: Healing begins with listening. Every feeling may bring its note; together we can help each one find room in the song.
arrival_dialogue.universal: Wellbeing begins with listening. Every feeling may bring its note; together we can help each one find room in the song.

quests.title: The Instruments That Went Quiet
quests.purpose: Associate feelings with sound choices while keeping the player's real-life feelings private.
quests.story_reason: Six garden instruments are waiting to be invited back into the kingdom's song.

tasks.title: Listen Without Guessing
tasks.mechanic_action: Preview curated motifs for joy, sadness, frustration, fear, peace, and hope without matching them to the player.
tasks.purpose: Explore emotional qualities without diagnostic inference.
tasks.story_reason: Each instrument wakes when heard fully rather than hurried into a label.
tasks.skip_policy: Visual pulse previews replace audio where needed.
tasks.replay_policy: Motifs can be replayed in any order with volume controls.

tasks.title: Give One Feeling a Voice
tasks.mechanic_action: Choose a feeling card for the fictional garden scene, then choose its instrument, colour, and tempo.
tasks.purpose: Practise expressive choice without requiring autobiography.
tasks.story_reason: A chosen voice grows the first singing flower beside the rail.
tasks.skip_policy: The neutral 'mystery feeling' card is equally valid.
tasks.replay_policy: Every feeling and combination may be revisited; no mood is rewarded more.

tasks.title: Answer the Garden's Echo
tasks.mechanic_action: Repeat or simplify a short call-and-response rhythm from the selected instrument.
tasks.purpose: Build attention and regulation through predictable musical turn-taking.
tasks.story_reason: The garden answers only when its voice is given room and then respectfully echoed.
tasks.skip_policy: Pulse once to echo; timing accuracy is not required.
tasks.replay_policy: Tempo may be slowed and attempts are unlimited.

quests.title: The Bridge That Needs Two Songs
quests.purpose: Practise empathy and cooperation by holding two distinct emotional perspectives.
quests.story_reason: The next rail bridge is woven from listening and response; one melody alone cannot span it.

tasks.title: Carry the First Melody
tasks.mechanic_action: Guide one character's motif through cooperative platforms while Milo carries a contrasting motif.
tasks.purpose: Experience an emotion as one valid part of a shared scene.
tasks.story_reason: The left half of the bridge grows when one voice is carried faithfully.
tasks.skip_policy: Solo-assist mode controls Milo automatically.
tasks.replay_policy: Character roles and motifs can be swapped.

tasks.title: Hear the Other Side
tasks.mechanic_action: Swap musical roles and use the other motif to reveal platforms that were previously hidden.
tasks.purpose: Represent perspective-taking without claiming to know another person's feelings.
tasks.story_reason: The second half appears when the player listens from a different musical position.
tasks.skip_policy: A guided demonstration counts as completion.
tasks.replay_policy: The swap can be repeated with different fictional feeling pairs.

tasks.title: Make Room for Both
tasks.mechanic_action: Adjust volume and tempo until both motifs remain audible in a player-chosen balance.
tasks.purpose: Practise regulation as making room, not suppressing a feeling.
tasks.story_reason: The bridge becomes stable when neither voice must disappear.
tasks.skip_policy: Any balance, including the default, is valid after listening once.
tasks.replay_policy: There is no optimal mix or emotional score.

quests.title: The Chord of Belonging
quests.purpose: Celebrate expression and connection while giving the train its harmonic key.
quests.story_reason: The kingdom's distinct voices become one jewel that preserves every note rather than blending them away.

tasks.title: Compose the Heart Constellation
tasks.mechanic_action: Place at least two unlocked feeling motifs on a short looping star staff and confirm when it feels complete.
tasks.purpose: Give authorship over an emotional musical journey.
tasks.story_reason: The loop calls the Harmony Jewel out of the garden fountain.
tasks.skip_policy: A curated two-note loop may be accepted unchanged.
tasks.replay_policy: Loops can be remixed; no composition is graded.

tasks.title: Receive the Harmony Jewel
tasks.mechanic_action: Choose Carry it or Let the train carry it; both place the Jewel in the journey compass.
tasks.purpose: Affirm emotional voice, empathy, and connection with a consent-respecting celebration.
tasks.story_reason: The Jewel tunes the Rainbow Galaxy Train for the road to Creator's Light.
tasks.skip_policy: Letting the train carry it grants identical progress.
tasks.replay_policy: Ceremony may replay; treasure is idempotent.

dialogue.speaker: Archangel Raphael
dialogue.faith: Your feelings matter. God can meet you in every note, and your heart has a beautiful voice.
dialogue.universal: Your feelings matter. Every note can have room, and your heart has a beautiful voice.

kingdom_arcs.title: Creator's Light Kingdom
kingdom_arcs.subtitle: The Gallery Beyond the Frame
kingdom_arcs.theme: I was created to create, and my choices can reveal meaning.
kingdom_arcs.purpose: Support imagination, creative identity, strength recognition, and purpose through art-making and reflection.
kingdom_arcs.story_reason: The final road cannot be found on an old map; the player must make an image that becomes a place only their choices could reveal.

arrival_dialogue.speaker: Uriel
arrival_dialogue.faith: The Creator's imagination echoes through yours. I will offer doors, but the colours, symbols, and meaning remain yours.
arrival_dialogue.universal: Your imagination can open paths no old map contains. I will offer doors, but the colours, symbols, and meaning remain yours.

quests.title: The Door No Map Could Draw
quests.purpose: Begin from a freely chosen prompt and protect the player's ownership of meaning.
quests.story_reason: A blank gallery wall becomes a doorway only after the player chooses what kind of light it might hold.

tasks.title: Choose Your Creative Door
tasks.mechanic_action: Choose one curated prompt from Identity, Courage, Emotions, Creativity, Purpose, or Free Create.
tasks.purpose: Offer direction without demanding personal disclosure.
tasks.story_reason: The chosen prompt becomes a prism-key for a unique gallery door.
tasks.skip_policy: Free Create contains no reflective question and is fully equivalent.
tasks.replay_policy: Prompts may be changed before saving and revisited later.

tasks.title: Make a Light Only You Would Make
tasks.mechanic_action: Use the offline ARTÉA drawing tools to add marks, shapes, colour, stamps, or an imported safe in-app motif.
tasks.purpose: Exercise creative agency and playful experimentation.
tasks.story_reason: Each intentional mark adds depth to the world waiting beyond the frame.
tasks.skip_policy: A single mark, stamp, or colour choice is enough; no quality threshold exists.
tasks.replay_policy: Undo, redo, restart, and pause are unlimited.

tasks.title: Name the Moment
tasks.mechanic_action: Save locally with a curated title, optional custom title, or Untitled Light.
tasks.purpose: Recognize completion while making personal naming optional.
tasks.story_reason: Saving anchors the image so its doorway can remain in the personal ARTÉA Gallery.
tasks.skip_policy: Untitled Light avoids text entry and completes normally.
tasks.replay_policy: Multiple versions may be saved; none replaces the player's original without confirmation.

quests.title: Step Through the Living Frame
quests.purpose: Translate 2D creative choices into spatial puzzle possibilities without judging symbolism.
quests.story_reason: The artwork becomes a viewfinder: placement changes the kingdom and reveals a path hidden behind ordinary perspective.

tasks.title: Place the Frame
tasks.mechanic_action: Position and scale the saved artwork against the 3D scene until one of several highlighted silhouettes aligns.
tasks.purpose: Explore perspective, spatial reasoning, and experimentation.
tasks.story_reason: The image becomes architecture where its edges meet the world's shapes.
tasks.skip_policy: Snap assist or automatic placement is always available.
tasks.replay_policy: Every valid alignment opens a different decorative path, never a better score.

tasks.title: Walk Into Your Perspective
tasks.mechanic_action: Confirm the frame to transform its visible forms into a navigable bridge, garden, creature trail, or constellation path.
tasks.purpose: Let the player experience creativity as consequential and world-making.
tasks.story_reason: The kingdom responds to the player's viewpoint and reveals the Keeper's tower.
tasks.skip_policy: A guided camera journey completes the transformation without navigation demands.
tasks.replay_policy: Return to the frame at any time; transformations do not overwrite the artwork.

tasks.title: Find the Unplanned Wonder
tasks.mechanic_action: Touch one emergent detail generated from authored mappings of colour, shape, and tool—not a model inference—and choose a wonder label.
tasks.purpose: Encourage curiosity while keeping interpretation with the player.
tasks.story_reason: The selected wonder becomes the motif carried back into the Castle Gallery.
tasks.skip_policy: Choose 'A mystery' to continue without interpretation.
tasks.replay_policy: Other authored wonders remain discoverable.

quests.title: The Gallery Frame Ritual
quests.purpose: Support self-reflection and purpose while explicitly refusing automated judgement.
quests.story_reason: Creator's Light awakens when the player claims a meaning or chooses mystery, then places the work among the Castle's stars.

tasks.title: Choose What You Want to Notice
tasks.mechanic_action: Milo offers curated prompts: proud part, strength used, story told, discovery, or Keep it mysterious; choose one response card or skip.
tasks.purpose: Invite self-authored reflection without AI evaluation or forced disclosure.
tasks.story_reason: The frame listens for the player's meaning rather than deciding it for them.
tasks.skip_policy: Keep it mysterious completes the task with equal affirmation and no reflection stored.
tasks.replay_policy: Responses may be revisited; the game never claims they reveal personality.

dialogue.speaker: Milo
dialogue.faith: Only you can choose what this creation means. The Maker delights in your creating; I am here to listen, not judge.
dialogue.universal: Only you can choose what this creation means. Your creativity matters; I am here to listen, not judge.

tasks.title: Place Your Work Among the Stars
tasks.mechanic_action: Select a curated gallery motif, preview placement, then Confirm or Undo before local display.
tasks.purpose: Provide consent, reversibility, and a tangible sense of belonging.
tasks.story_reason: The Gallery gains a new window into the player's journey.
tasks.skip_policy: A private unshown frame still completes the ritual and remains local.
tasks.replay_policy: Placement and motif can be changed or removed later.

tasks.title: Receive the Creator's Light
tasks.mechanic_action: Choose Hold the Light or Let it shine from the artwork; both add Creator's Light to the compass.
tasks.purpose: Affirm creativity, identity, strengths, and purpose without grading the artwork.
tasks.story_reason: The third treasure wakes the Castle and completes the route of the Rainbow Galaxy Train.
tasks.skip_policy: Letting the artwork hold the Light grants identical progress.
tasks.replay_policy: Ceremony may replay; treasure is idempotent.

dialogue.speaker: Uriel
dialogue.faith: Your creativity is a gift from the Creator, expressed in a way only you can share.
dialogue.universal: Your creativity is a gift, expressed in a way only you can share.

castle_interludes.title: The Observatory Remembers
castle_interludes.purpose: Show that Mind Spark changed the shared Castle and establish Heart Melody's need.
castle_interludes.story_reason: The Star of Wisdom lights an observatory lens, revealing a silent music rail that needs emotional voices.

dialogue.speaker: Milo
dialogue.faith: Wisdom has opened the way. The Maker welcomes every honest feeling; let us listen for the Heart Kingdom's song.
dialogue.universal: Wisdom has opened the way. Every honest feeling can have room; let us listen for the Heart Kingdom's song.

castle_interludes.title: The Train Finds Its Chord
castle_interludes.purpose: Connect emotional expression to the creative world and foreshadow the finale ride.
castle_interludes.story_reason: The Harmony Jewel gives the Rainbow Galaxy Train a voice, but its final destination must be imagined into existence.

dialogue.speaker: Milo
dialogue.faith: Your heart's music has tuned the train. Now the creative light placed within you can reveal where its last rail leads.
dialogue.universal: Your heart's music has tuned the train. Now your creative light can reveal where its last rail leads.

castle_interludes.title: The Gallery Becomes a Universe
castle_interludes.purpose: Gather the three accomplishments without reducing the player to a score.
castle_interludes.story_reason: Wisdom gives direction, Harmony gives connection, and Creativity gives form; together they awaken the Light of Identity.

dialogue.speaker: Milo
dialogue.faith: The gifts the Maker placed within you are shining together. The Castle is ready to celebrate your story.
dialogue.universal: Your gifts are shining together. The Castle is ready to celebrate your story.

finale.title: The Crown of Life Celebration
finale.purpose: Celebrate the player's unique journey, preserve choice around faith/body/name presentation, and open continued play.
finale.story_reason: The three treasures resonate as the Light of Identity, allowing the whole Castle universe to answer the player's authored path.
beats: Star of Wisdom, Harmony Jewel, and Creator's Light combine as the Light of Identity without losing their individual forms.
The Rainbow Galaxy Train carries the player past constellations of brave choices, musical moments, and their locally saved gallery art.
The celebrant shapes a symbolic Crown of Life; the player chooses Wear, Hold, Display nearby, or Watch the light only.
The player may type a display name, choose a local profile name, choose 'My Light', or skip the named-star moment entirely.
A final portal opens Free Journey mode: replay kingdoms, remix music, add art, or rest in the Castle with no lost progress.

celebrant.universal: The Keeper of the Living Gallery

dialogue.speaker: Celebrant
dialogue.faith: You are known and loved. God created you with unique gifts and purpose. Your story matters, and your light has a place in this universe.
dialogue.universal: You are known and valued. You carry unique gifts and purpose. Your story matters, and your light has a place in this universe.

name_star.privacy: Local display only by default; never upload, share, or expose a child's name without a separate verified adult-controlled flow.

skip_text.faith: The Maker knows your name even when you keep it private.
skip_text.universal: Your light belongs here even when you keep your name private.
